* Reconcile planned against actual hours weekly and report hours-requirement accuracy.
* Check driven appointment volume against NP slot capacity with Clinical Operations before raising hours.

**Vendor workforce governance**

* Measure staffed hours delivered by each vendor against the locked requirement, by week and interval, using Genesys data.
* Enforce the SOW's workforce terms: interval staffing floor, billable hours cap, efficiency floor, adherence target, flex notices and overtime pre-authorization.
* Reconcile invoiced payroll hours against Genesys login hours monthly, and document variances and credits owed.
* Own the workforce measures in the joint vendor scorecard, and prepare workforce content for weekly reviews, monthly performance reviews and QBRs.
* Track vendor attrition, ramp and hiring-wave delivery against plan.

**Genesys Cloud workforce management (business owner)**

* Design the business unit and management unit structure (one unit per vendor), with adherence rules and permissions for each.
* Define activity-code mapping so productive hours mean on-queue and campaign time, matching the SOW definition. Genesys defaults count meetings and training as work time.
* Ensure every vendor's schedules exist in Genesys, built there or imported, so adherence is measured on Matrix's platform.
* Own adherence, shrinkage and staffed-hours reporting from Genesys.
* Use Genesys forecasting and capacity planning for inbound work such as member callbacks.

**Outbound campaign strategy**

* Decide list segmentation and allocation by vendor and campaign. Each contact list runs on one campaign at a time, so list allocation is the main lever for splitting volume.
* Set dialing mode, calling windows by member time zone, abandon-rate thresholds and attempt cadence within Matrix's dialer rules, including the 20-attempt annual cap.
* Partner with telecom on caller ID and attestation to protect contact rate.
* Genesys administrators carry out configuration changes; this role decides them.

**Daily allocation and channel monitoring**

* Review prior-day performance by source: contact rate, acceptance rate, LCPH, scheduled and completed visits.
* Make same-day list and hours adjustments within the decision rights below.
* Watch disposition trends for signs that a model input has drifted.
* Track text, IVR and print response as inputs to voice hours, and as scope expands, recommend channel-mix shifts.

**Reporting and leadership support**

* Build and maintain the vendor scorecard and capacity dashboards in Power BI.
* Produce a monthly capacity outlook and channel performance summary with explicit recommendations.
* Contribute to ExCo materials, growing toward presenting portions of them.

The United States Space Force (USSF) Space Systems Command (SSC) at Los Angeles Air Force Base, California is searching for a Supervisor, Cost Analyst, SYD 84/S8C (NH-1515-03, GS 12/13 equivalent).
  
  
**Description**:
  
The Finance Office provides financial management and decision support to programs in the Missile Warning & Tracking Portfolio; enabling planning and execution of acquisition strategies and delivery of space capabilities in support of United States Space Force and Department of War. The Portfolio includes Strategic Missile Warning Space Programs and Resilient Missile Warning & Tracking Programs in proto-typing, development, pre-production and sustainment phase. This supervisory role will oversee civilian and/or military personnel and manage contractor personnel providing support to various program offices.
  
  
Are you interested in supporting advanced space technologies in one of the most diverse areas in the country? Come join our team here in sunny Southern California at Space Systems Command. We are located in the city of El Segundo, gateway to the beaches. The area offers a multitude of sandy choices, from Santa Monica to Redondo with plenty of things to do in between including hiking trails, breweries, sporting events, museums, piers, theme parks, zoos, and more. There is only 1 place in the world where you can surf and snowboard all in the same day, and it is in Southern California!
  
  
Space Systems Command is the U.S. Space Force (USSF) center of excellence for acquiring and developing military space systems. It manages ~ $9 billion annual budget and employs over 6000 military, civilian and contractor personnel at Los Angeles AFB and other locations worldwide.
  
  
We offer incentives for both recruitment and relocation. You may qualify for a one-time cash payment in accordance with agency policy.

The ideal candidate for the Supervisor Cost Analyst position is a highly analytical and experienced professional possessing a bachelor's or higher degree that includes at least 24 semester hours in a combination of operations research, mathematics, probability, statistics, mathematical logic, science, or subject-matter courses demonstrating substantial competence in college-level mathematics or statistics, with at least 3 of those semester hours specifically in Calculus. Additionally, a Defense Acquisition Workforce Improvement Act (DAWIA) Certification in Cost Estimating, or an equivalent industry-recognized cost estimating certification, is highly preferred to ensure immediate mission readiness and alignment with rigorous Department of War standards.
  
  
**Key Skills and Abilities**:

* Knowledge of a broad range of operations research analysis techniques and possession of analytical abilities.

* Knowledge of quantitative techniques and methods used to develop, adapt, modify and apply models to resolve problems or define and clarify alternative solutions.

* Skill to negotiate and/or defend findings and program support concepts.

* Ability to lead study teams and originate new ideas, projects, and methodologies; and execute projects and/or studies within established financial and/or time constraints.

* Ability to develop and utilize appropriate data collection techniques, design, build, and use models and simulation techniques.

  

**Requirements**
----------------

### **Conditions of employment**

* U.S. Citizenship Required
* Must be able to obtain and maintain a Top-Secret security clearance.
* Required to handle and safeguard classified or sensitive information in accordance with regulations to reduce potential compromise.
* This position has been designated for drug testing. Incumbent is subject to random urinalysis testing as a condition of employment.

**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

It’s a new Day 1 for Leo, and we are looking for team members to join the Accounting PMO supporting this emerging business.  
This position supports the launch and expansion of Amazon Leo by contributing to strategic initiatives that help grow and scale the business. You will support controllership and scalability as you partner with global stakeholders — including business product managers, financial technology teams, accounting operations, business finance, tax, treasury, and others — to deliver highly scalable, secure, and flexible financial solutions. You operate effectively in a fast-paced, global, results-oriented environment. Strong oral and written communication skills are essential, along with the ability to think clearly, analyze quantitatively, problem-solve, scope business requirements, and prioritize.  
Successful candidates bring experience across three disciplines: Accounting, Program Management, and Financial Systems Implementation. This role requires financial accounting knowledge, experience working with technology teams to design and build financial systems integration solutions, and the ability to support the launch and ongoing management of a financial integration program. You contribute to cross-functional decision-making and help drive implementation across a global scope, balancing time to market with investments in automation.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Support cross-functional programs: Contribute to new and evolving programs by supporting end-to-end implementation activities, developing processes, metrics, documentation, and communications, and driving continuous improvement.
* Partner with delivery teams: Collaborate with worldwide business, technology, and product teams to deliver high-quality program outcomes on time.
* Analyze and recommend: Gather data, analyze results, and provide feedback on priorities, timelines, and outcomes to support business process decisions and scale financial recordkeeping health.
* Communicate program status: Prepare clear updates and recommendations for stakeholders, translating complex information into actionable summaries for peers and leadership.
* Build relationships: Collaborate with business, product, accounting, technology, and finance owners globally to support scalable financial automation with the highest degree of controllership.
* Identify risks proactively: Surface potential issues early, propose mitigation options, and escalate appropriately to set the team up for success.

  
A day in the life  
Your day typically begins with reviewing overnight readiness metrics and flagging critical issues that require attention.  
Throughout the day, you:  

* Track key readiness activities and follow up with teams on readiness status and test progress.
* Monitor test statistics, assist with testing activities, and validate accounting flows.
* Analyze accounting test results and prepare recommendations for your team lead and stakeholders.
* Provide guidance to partner delivery teams on accounting requirements and help drive issues to resolution — including identifying alternative solution options.
* Prepare data-driven inputs for leadership meetings, translating complex analytics into clear summaries.

Our Finance team serves as a trusted partner to the business, providing the financial perspective leaders need to make informed decisions. We are a collaborative group that values analytical rigor, continuous improvement, and knowledge sharing. * 3+ years of finance or a related analytical field experience

* 2+ years of Fortune 500 operational accounting experience

* Knowledge of internal control framework (specifically COSO) to assess control design and operational efficiency
* Knowledge of GAAP research tools and the FASB codification

Join the California State University (CSU) and explore career opportunities that advance student success and strengthen California’s future—offering competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and professional growth.

### **Job Summary**

The College of Natural Sciences and Mathematics (CNSM) Facilities Coordinator is a full-time position that reports to and works closely with the Associate Dean for Research, Facilities, and Graduate Studies. The coordinator serves as the CNSM primary liaison to Beach Building Services (BBS)/Physical Planning and Facilities Management (PPFM) and is responsible for coordinating, planning, and overseeing facilities-related operations, projects, and communications across the college. This role ensures effective execution of facilities projects, supports research and teaching infrastructure needs, manages emergency response coordination, and provides centralized communication between CNSM departments and campus facilities units.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Facilities Planning and Project Coordination. Independently prioritize and coordinate routine facility operations, maintenance requests, and work orders, exercising judgment to resolve operational issues efficiently.
* Laboratory and Infrastructure Support. Coordinate and assist faculty and staff with large equipment and supply deliveries to teaching and research laboratories.
* Facilities Communication and Liaison Functions. Serve as the primary point of contact for all CNSM facilities-related inquiries from departments, faculty, and staff.
* Emergency Response and Issue Management. Assist faculty with any emergencies (during the day or after hours) such as freezer failures to save samples, reagents and stocks etc.
* Operational Coordination and Logistics. Schedule, coordinate, and oversee the tri-annual CNSM junk and surplus pickup by BBS.
* Resource and Asset Management. Manage the CNSM poster board rental system, including scheduling, tracking usage, and invoicing renting units.

### **Department**

College of Natural Sciences and Mathematics Dean's Office

### **Time Base**

1.0 time-base, 40 hours per week.

### **Duration of Appointment**

This is a temporary position for one year with no permanent status granted. Temporary assignments may expire prior to the ending date.

### **Classification**

Administrative Analyst/Specialist Exempt I

The City of Seal Beach is seeking a resourceful, collaborative professional to serve as a Management Analyst in the City Manager's Office. This position offers broad exposure to municipal management, City Council priorities, community issues, and citywide initiatives.

The position assists with City Council matters, policy research, public communications and events, constituent services, intergovernmental coordination, assist with management of the waste franchise agreement and state compliance, and special projects. jobs.description:
#### **Senior Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) Analyst**

**R.F. MacDonald Co. | A Cleaver-Brooks Company**

  

**Location:** Hayward, CA  
**Work Arrangement:** Onsite  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time | Exempt

#### **About R.F. MacDonald Co.**

Founded in 1956, R.F. MacDonald Co. (RFM) has built a strong reputation as a trusted provider of boiler and pump solutions for commercial and industrial customers throughout California and Nevada. With nearly 300 employees, RFM specializes in equipment sales, engineering, installation support, maintenance, and field service, delivering innovative solutions and exceptional customer support.

Now proudly a Cleaver-Brooks company, R.F. MacDonald is entering an exciting new chapter of growth. Our partnership combines RFM's longstanding customer relationships, technical expertise, and service capabilities with the resources and industry leadership of Cleaver-Brooks, a global leader in integrated boiler and thermal energy solutions.

Together, we're building on nearly 70 years of experience while creating new opportunities for innovation, collaboration, and continued growth.

R.F. MacDonald Co. is seeking a Senior Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) Analyst to join our Finance team.

This is an opportunity for an analytical, business-minded finance professional who enjoys working beyond the numbers to help drive business performance and strategic decisions.

In this role, you'll partner with leadership and cross-functional teams to support financial planning, forecasting, budgeting, and performance analysis. You'll play an important role in translating financial data into meaningful insights, identifying opportunities for improvement, and helping shape the company's financial strategies.

* **Evaluate growth opportunities:** Provide financial analysis to support potential investments, acquisitions, and other strategic business decisions.

* **Support special projects:** Conduct ad hoc financial analyses and provide recommendations to leadership as business needs evolve.

#### **What We're Looking For**

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, or a related field.
* 4+ years of experience in financial planning and analysis, accounting, or a related finance function.
* Strong financial modeling, forecasting, budgeting, and analytical capabilities.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and experience working with financial reporting systems.
* Solid understanding of GAAP, financial statements, and accounting principles.
* Ability to analyze complex financial information and communicate findings clearly to business leaders.
* Strong organizational, problem-solving, and communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, work independently, and collaborate effectively across teams.
  

#### **Preferred Qualifications**

* 5–8 years of progressive experience in Finance, Accounting, or a related discipline.
* Experience with NetSuite and/or Adaptive Planning.
* Experience in the construction, industrial services, or related industries.
* Experience supporting financial analysis across multiple business units or operational functions.

#### **Why Join R.F. MacDonald Co.?**

At R.F. MacDonald, you'll join an established organization with a history of technical expertise, strong customer relationships, and a commitment to its employees. As part of Cleaver-Brooks, we're building on that foundation with expanded resources, capabilities, and opportunities for continued growth. This position offers the opportunity to collaborate with business leaders, contribute to meaningful financial decisions, and play an important role in supporting the company's future success.

##### **Ready to make an impact?** **If you're a finance professional who enjoys solving problems, turning data into actionable insights, and partnering with others to drive results, we'd like to hear from you.**

##### **Apply today and explore your future with R.F. MacDonald Co., a Cleaver-Brooks company.**

jobs.title: Economic Vitality Analyst (Administrative Analyst III)
jobs.description:
**ABOUT US**
------------

At the County of Marin, our employees overwhelmingly report feeling their work is meaningful, they like the work they do, and they are proud to tell people “I work for the County of Marin.” Discover more about us, our values and our organizational culture here. Read on to find out more about this opportunity.

  
  

**ABOUT THE DEPARTMENT**

The Office of the County Executive is responsible for implementing the policy direction of the Marin County Board of Supervisors and supporting the effective delivery of public services across 22 departments. The Office leads countywide initiatives and coordinates work that crosses departments, jurisdictions, and sectors.

In 2025, the Board of Supervisors established Community and Economic Vitality as a countywide priority and directed the development of Marin's first comprehensive, regional Economic Vitality Roadmap. The Roadmap brings together the County, Marin's 11 cities and towns, businesses, educational institutions, community organizations, and other partners to develop a shared vision and actionable strategies for Marin's economic future.

The Roadmap will explore opportunities related to vibrant downtown and commercial areas, workforce and housing, small business and entrepreneurship, agriculture and working lands, tourism, arts and culture, innovation, and long-term economic resilience.

**ABOUT THE POSITION**
----------------------

The Economic Vitality Analyst is part of the Office of the County Executive's newly established Economic Vitality and Municipal Services Division. Reporting directly to the Director of Economic Vitality and Municipal Services, the Analyst will be dedicated to supporting the County's emerging economic vitality function and the development and implementation of the **Economic Vitality Roadmap** which was approved by the Board in June 2026.

This is a unique opportunity to help build a new, high-priority County function from the ground up. The successful candidate has experience or knowledge related to economic development, economic or fiscal analysis, business engagement, workforce development, housing, downtown or commercial district revitalization, placemaking, entrepreneurship, agriculture, tourism, arts and culture, or regional collaboration is required. They will join the Economic Vitality and Municipal Services Division at an early stage in its development and will have an opportunity to help turn a countywide strategy into tangible programs, partnerships, and projects.

Working closely with the Director, the Analyst will conduct research and analysis, coordinate projects, support stakeholder engagement, and help develop and implement economic vitality initiatives. The position will work across County departments and extensively with Marin's cities and towns, businesses and business organizations, educational and workforce partners, community-based organizations, and other public and private partners.

The Analyst will be part of a small, collaborative Division that also includes two Municipal Services Managers serving West Marin and Marin City. While those positions lead place-based work within their respective communities, the Economic Vitality Analyst will primarily focus on countywide and regional economic vitality initiatives, working alongside the Municipal Services Managers to ensure that the Roadmap and its implementation reflect the distinct opportunities and priorities of Marin's unincorporated communities.

Key responsibilities for the Analyst may include:

* **Program and project development:**Research, develop, and help implement new programs and initiatives emerging from the Roadmap, including preparing project scopes, work plans, analyses, recommendations, and implementation materials.
* **Funding and resource development:** Research potential grants, partnerships, and other funding opportunities that could support implementation of Roadmap priorities and assist with funding strategies and applications.
* **Communications and presentations:** Prepare reports, presentations, briefing materials, correspondence, and other materials for the Director, County Executive, Board of Supervisors, advisory groups, partner organizations, and the public.
* **Advisory and stakeholder bodies:** Provide staff support for the Economic Vitality Roadmap Advisory Committee and other working groups, including developing meeting materials, conducting follow-up research, coordinating partners, and tracking action items.
* **Economic and policy analysis:** Review and analyze economic, demographic, workforce, business, housing, and other data; review consultant analyses and recommendations; research economic development models and best practices; and translate complex information into clear findings and recommendations for County leadership and partners.
* **Roadmap development and implementation:** Support development of the Economic Vitality Roadmap and help translate its recommendations into implementation plans, projects, partnerships, timelines, and measurable outcomes. Help develop measures of success, track implementation progress, analyze program outcomes, and prepare updates on the County's economic vitality work.
* **Regional coordination:** Work with peers at Marin's 11 cities and towns and other public agencies to advance shared economic vitality strategies and identify opportunities for coordinated regional action.
* **Business and stakeholder engagement:** Support the Director in building relationships with local businesses, chambers and business organizations, educational institutions, workforce partners, community-based organizations, nonprofits, philanthropy, and other stakeholders.
* **Cross-departmental collaboration:** Coordinate with County departments on initiatives that intersect with economic vitality, including housing, workforce development, transportation, planning, climate and sustainability, infrastructure, arts and culture, and community development.

is hiring. Let us introduce ourselves. Swift is changing the way we navigate and understand the world. Swift’s precise positioning technology platform improves location accuracy from several meters to centimeter-level and is used by millions of devices across the globe. Swift’s technology is trusted by users across industries, enabling safer driving, improving efficiency for last-mile delivery and commercial transport operations, increasing accuracy for mobile devices, and creating new possibilities for rail, robotics and machine control. That’s what we offer our customers and partners, but it’s the work we do together as a team that is the best part of our days. We collaborate—across the globe—to tackle problems, to pursue our mission, and to make a real impact in the world. We are diverse, flexible, and supportive, and we believe our team is our most important asset, and we offer a host of benefits and programs to ensure that they know it.

  

Swift Navigation is looking for an outstanding Senior FP&A Analyst to drive annual budgeting, build forecasting models, track and analyze KPIs/metrics, and provide strategic insights as our business grows. This includes developing, optimizing, and maintaining FP&A datasets and reporting platforms. The FP&A Analyst will play a key role by delivering accurate and timely information for our investors, board members, and our internal stakeholders.

  

You guide our executive team to make sound financial decisions. You help save the company money by decreasing costs and identifying/eliminating inefficiencies. You seek to understand business drivers and KPIs, and you have a deep understanding of and comfort with SaaS metrics. You are the ultimate team player, able to collaborate and build effective relationships throughout the company. You are curious, take initiative, have a bias for action, and possess strong organizational and communication skills. The company is based in San Francisco.

**Duties/Responsibilities:**

Develop and manage monthly, quarterly, annual, and long-term financial planning, including creation and maintenance of predictable and accurate financial models.



Develop and prepare automated monthly reporting packages with financial metrics/KPI, ratios, charts, graphs, dashboards and other data visualization tools. Develop an in-depth understanding of key business drivers and unit economics, particularly those related to SaaS businesses.



Conduct performance, forecast, and financial metric reviews with the leadership team and recommend actions to improve operating/capital efficiency and business profitability. Drive actuals vs. forecast variance analysis, identifying causes of change and highlighting risks and opportunities for improvement.



Use AI and data-driven analysis to continually improve forecast accuracy and efficiency.



Coordinate with all levels of management to gather inputs and to provide valuable performance analysis and management reporting by highlighting key business performance risks, issues and opportunities. Establish yourself as a subject matter expert, trusted partner assisting in accurate forecasting, strategic analysis, and ad-hoc analysis/reporting.



Support management with analyses on project profitability, pricing, and ROI of new product and program initiatives.

jobs.title: Senior Compliance Analyst
jobs.description:
### **About HMA**

  

HMA Mortgage is a retail independent mortgage bank licensed in 35 jurisdictions. Our Compliance team protects the company from regulatory, financial, and reputational loss while keeping originations moving. As a Senior Compliance Analyst, you will independently own critical regulatory reporting, serve as a go-to resource for the business on day-to-day compliance questions, and help us stay exam-ready. You will work directly with senior leadership and have real influence on how our compliance program grows.

  

### **What You'll Do**

**Regulatory Reporting**

  

* Serve as the owner of the company's regulatory reporting — HMDA (LAR), the quarterly Mortgage Call Report, and NMLS state reporting — accountable for accuracy, the submission calendar, and the supporting documentation, running the reporting cycle independently with the SVP as oversight.

* Own HMDA data integrity end to end: scrub, validate, correct, and submit the annual LAR, and perform ongoing quarterly checks.

* Prepare and submit the quarterly Mortgage Call Report (MCR) and state-level reporting through NMLS, with accurate reconciliation to financial and loan data.

* Prepare and file annual state mortgage reports, as applicable by jurisdiction, including state-specific annual filings submitted through NMLS or directly to the state regulator, and track each state’s requirements and due dates.

  

**Compliance Advisory and Monitoring**

  

* Serve as the first point of contact for business-line questions on TRID, RESPA, TILA, ECOA/Reg B, GLBA, and UDAAP, escalating complex or high-risk issues to the SVP.

* Review marketing, advertising, and social media content for compliance before use.

* Conduct risk-based transactional testing and monitoring, document findings, and track remediation to closure.

* Perform root cause analysis on errors and recommend control improvements.

  

**Licensing and Third-Party Oversight**

  

* Own the third-party risk program end to end — maintain the vendor inventory and risk tiering, collect and review due diligence materials (financials, SOC reports, insurance, licensing, information security questionnaires , track remediation and periodic reviews through the vendor inventory, and escalating high-risk issues to the SVP.

* Support company and individual licensing: applications, renewals, amendments, and multi-state requirements.

* Monitor Marketing Services Agreements (MSAs) and similar referral arrangements for RESPA Section 8 compliance, including fair-market-value support, payment review, and periodic testing.

  

**Audits and Examinations**

  

* Coordinate regulator, investor, and internal audit requests: gather loan files and data, prepare responses, and track findings.

* Help draft exam responses and corrective action plans.

  

**Compliance Program Support**

  

* Monitor regulatory changes and flag business impact.

* Help maintain policies, procedures, and training content.

* Produce clear, concise reporting for leadership.

* Coordinate and oversee the work of third-party compliance resources (e.g., outsourced consultants or testing firms): communicate scope and deadlines, review deliverables for quality and completeness, track findings and remediation, and escalate performance or risk concerns to the SVP.

  

### **What You Bring**

  

* 5+ years of mortgage compliance experience, including hands-on HMDA and MCR preparation.
* Working knowledge of TRID, RESPA, TILA, ECOA, GLBA, and UDAAP, as applied to real loan files.
* Experience supporting regulatory or investor exams and audits.
* Strong analytical skills and comfort with large data sets (advanced Excel required; HMDA software and LOS experience a plus).
* Clear, concise writing, and the judgment to explain risk in business terms.
* Self-starter who thrives in a small team and can manage multiple deadlines without close supervision.
* Experience working with outside consultants or service providers and holding them to deliverables and timelines (preferred).
* Experience with third-party/vendor risk management, including due diligence reviews and risk assessments (preferred).
* Bachelor's degree preferred, or equivalent experience.

Preferred: CRCM or similar certification; experience with multi-state licensing and NMLS; experience in a retail origination environment.  

**HMA****Core Values in This Role**

These values are the behavioral standard for the role, assessed alongside results. Results delivered in a way that violates them do not count as results.

* **Integrity —** a compliance position is defensible on the regulation and the record, not on who is asking for the answer. Pressure never changes what the rule requires.

* **Grit —** the hard regulatory question gets the full analysis, not a convenient read. Rule changes, new reporting cycles, and exam pressure are absorbed without a drop in quality.

* **Accountability —** regulatory accuracy belongs to this seat. When a finding or error lands, this role arrives with the cause, the correction, and the control that prevents a repeat.

* **Service —** the business lines, Sales, and leadership are all customers. The test is whether the next person can act on the guidance without chasing it, and move the loan forward compliantly.

* **Humility —** root cause is pursued even when it points at our own process. Getting the control right matters more than being right about who caused the gap.

* **Speed of Response —** compliance questions and escalations receive a response inside a defined window. The acknowledgment is owed immediately; the answer is owed on a clock.

  

**Equal Opportunity**

HMA Mortgage is an equal opportunity employer. This job description describes the general nature of the role and is not an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, or skills required.

jobs.title: Accounting Analyst
jobs.description:
**Position Title:** Accounting Analyst

**Location:** Remote

**Type:** Full Time

**The Opportunity:**

This is a rare ground-floor opportunity to help build Ohalo's accounting and finance infrastructure and business processes from the ground up, and to be at the forefront of building a best-in-class finance organization. Reporting to the Controller, the Accounting Analyst will own day-to-day accounts payable, cash reconciliations, and core general ledger activity — bringing an analytical, process-minded approach to work that is hands-on by nature, with real influence over how those processes are built and improved as Ohalo scales. We're looking for someone who diagnoses the root cause upstream rather than treating symptoms and applying band-aids on the back end.

**Responsibilities:**

* Process, code, and review vendor invoices and employee expense reports, and manage the AP workflow end-to-end using Ramp/Zip and NetSuite
* Own vendor and payment reconciliations, analyzing root cause on discrepancies, and aged items rather than just correcting the transaction
* Prepare and post monthly corporate accounting journal entries (accruals, prepaids, reclasses, and other standard entries)
* Perform monthly balance sheet reconciliations for cash and other assigned accounts, ensuring timely resolution of reconciling items
* Reconcile bank and cash accounts on a recurring basis and monitor for unusual activity
* Support month-end, quarterly, and year-end close, including flux analysis and supporting schedules
* Identify and help implement opportunities to automate manual, repetitive AP and reconciliation work using AI tools and workflow automation
* Partner with procurement, budget owners, and vendors to resolve invoice and payment issues, and maintain audit-ready documentation
* Administer Ohalo's travel & expense (T&E) program — card issuance, policy enforcement, and receipt compliance — and perform periodic transaction audits. Leverage AI-tools within Ramp to pre-audit expenses back to policy.

  

**Required Qualifications:**

* 2+ years of accounting or accounts payable experience
* Solid understanding of debits/credits and general accounting principles (GAAP)
* Self-starter who takes ownership and reasons from first principles rather than defaulting to "how it's always been done"
* Strong intellectual curiosity and problem-solving skills — comfortable digging into root cause rather than just closing out a task

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Working knowledge of NetSuite, Ramp and Zip (or a similar procurement/AP automation platform)
* Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field
* Prior experience at a high-growth or fast-paced company
* Comfortable using AI tools to speed up and improve repetitive accounting work

  

***This role is available to individuals working in the Pacific, Mountain, or Central Time Zones. Compensation will depend on the working location of the individual hired. However, the anticipated base pay range for this role is $65,000-80,000 per year for our South San Francisco*** *location. The pay offered to a selected candidate will be determined based on factors such as (but not limited to) the scope and responsibilities of the position, the qualifications of the selected candidate, budget availability, internal equity, geographic location and external market pay for comparable jobs.*

**About Ohalo:**

Ohalo™ aims to accelerate evolution to unlock nature's potential. Founded in 2019, Ohalo develops novel breeding systems and improved plant varieties that help farmers grow more food with fewer natural resources, increasing the yield, resiliency, and genetic diversity of crops to sustainably feed our population. Ohalo's breakthrough technology, Boosted Breeding™, will usher in a new era of improved productivity to radically transform global agriculture. For more information, visit www.ohalo.com.

*Notes: If you previously applied for a job at Ohalo Genetics, we encourage you to restate your interest in the position by submitting your application.*

  

*Ohalo is an Equal Opportunity / Affirmative Action employer committed to diversity in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, gender identity or any other factor protected by applicable federal, state or local laws. Ohalo is also committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities. Please let your recruiter know if you need an accommodation at any point during the interview process.*

*This organization participates in E-Verify. Posters linked* *here.*

*No recruiters, please.*

The United States Space Force (USSF) Space Systems Command (SSC) at Los Angeles Air Force Base, California is searching for a Supervisor, Cost Analyst, SYD 84/S8C (NH-1515-03, GS 12/13 equivalent).
  
  
**Description**:
  
The Finance Office provides financial management and decision support to programs in the Missile Warning & Tracking Portfolio; enabling planning and execution of acquisition strategies and delivery of space capabilities in support of United States Space Force and Department of War. The Portfolio includes Strategic Missile Warning Space Programs and Resilient Missile Warning & Tracking Programs in proto-typing, development, pre-production and sustainment phase. This supervisory role will oversee civilian and/or military personnel and manage contractor personnel providing support to various program offices.
  
  
Are you interested in supporting advanced space technologies in one of the most diverse areas in the country? Come join our team here in sunny Southern California at Space Systems Command. We are located in the city of El Segundo, gateway to the beaches. The area offers a multitude of sandy choices, from Santa Monica to Redondo with plenty of things to do in between including hiking trails, breweries, sporting events, museums, piers, theme parks, zoos, and more. There is only 1 place in the world where you can surf and snowboard all in the same day, and it is in Southern California!
  
  
Space Systems Command is the U.S. Space Force (USSF) center of excellence for acquiring and developing military space systems. It manages ~ $9 billion annual budget and employs over 6000 military, civilian and contractor personnel at Los Angeles AFB and other locations worldwide.
  
  
We offer incentives for both recruitment and relocation. You may qualify for a one-time cash payment in accordance with agency policy.

* Knowledge of a broad range of operations research analysis techniques and possession of analytical abilities.

* Knowledge of quantitative techniques and methods used to develop, adapt, modify and apply models to resolve problems or define and clarify alternative solutions.

* Skill to negotiate and/or defend findings and program support concepts.

* Ability to lead study teams and originate new ideas, projects, and methodologies; and execute projects and/or studies within established financial and/or time constraints.

* Ability to develop and utilize appropriate data collection techniques, design, build, and use models and simulation techniques.

  

**Requirements**
----------------

### **Conditions of employment**

* Must be able to obtain and maintain a Top-Secret security clearance.
* Required to handle and safeguard classified or sensitive information in accordance with regulations to reduce potential compromise.

**Description**
---------------

**Description**

The City of Seal Beach is seeking a resourceful, collaborative professional to serve as a Management Analyst in the City Manager's Office. This position offers broad exposure to municipal management, City Council priorities, community issues, and citywide initiatives.

Under general direction, the Management Analyst performs responsible professional administrative, analytical, and project coordination work supporting the City Manager. The position assists with City Council matters, policy research, public communications and events, constituent services, intergovernmental coordination, assist with management of the waste franchise agreement and state compliance, and special projects. Assignments require sound judgment, initiative, discretion, and effective working relationships across the organization and community.

**The Ideal Candidate**

The City is seeking a candidate who is enthusiastic about building a long-term career with Seal Beach and making a lasting contribution to the organization and community. The ideal candidate will value professional relationships, organizational continuity, and the opportunity to grow with the City while helping advance its goals and priorities over the years ahead.

**Examples of Duties**
----------------------

The following primary duty areas illustrate the scope of the assignment. Duties may vary based on operational needs and City priorities. Assignments and priorities are established by the CM or designee.

**1. Executive and Policy Support:** Conduct research and analysis, prepare briefings and correspondence, and assist the City Manager with organizational priorities, policy issues, and executive-level assignments, assists with the management of the waste franchise agreement and state compliance related to SB 1383 and related matters.

**2. City Council Agenda and Follow-Up:** Assist with preparation and review of agenda materials, staff reports, resolutions, presentations, and supporting documents; track Council direction and related department follow-up through the City Manager's Office.

**3. Citywide Projects and Initiatives:** Assist with planning, organizing and monitoring special projects.Plan, organize, and monitor special projects, including the annual Strategic Plan, involving multiple departments, consultants, or other stakeholders; establish schedules, track deliverables, and report progress and recommendations.

**4. Constituent and Community Relations:** Research and respond to resident, business, and community organization inquiries; coordinate with departments to address complex or sensitive concerns and ensure timely, professional follow-through.

**5. Public Information and Engagement:** Lead and assist communications efforts via written and other communications including the City Manager newsletter, updating the website, creating and sharing social media posts, writing public notices and press releases, sharing presentations, assisting with community engagement, public workshops; develop outreach efforts, including community events, to communicate City programs and priorities.

**6. Interdepartmental Coordination:** Facilitate communication and problem solving across City departments; coordinate assignments, information requests including Public Records Act requests, operational improvements, and cross-functional activities on behalf of the City Manager's Office.

**7. Intergovernmental and Stakeholder Relations:** Support coordination and communication with regional, county, state, and federal agencies and legislative offices, neighboring jurisdictions, community partners, and professional organizations on issues affecting the City.

**8. Research, Performance, and Program Evaluation:** Analyze policies, legislative developments, service delivery issues, and administrative processes; develop recommendations and assist with tracking organizational goals, performance measures, and strategic initiatives.

**9. Administrative and Financial Projects:** Perform budget, contract, grant, and operational analyses as assigned including preparing the annual budget for the City Manager’s Office and City Council; prepare management reports; manage contracts and grants related to SB 1383 and complete invoices and tracking; coordinate assigned committee or meeting activities, and support implementation of approved recommendations.

Performs other related duties as assigned.

**ABOUT THE DEPARTMENT**

The Office of the County Executive is responsible for implementing the policy direction of the Marin County Board of Supervisors and supporting the effective delivery of public services across 22 departments. The Office leads countywide initiatives and coordinates work that crosses departments, jurisdictions, and sectors.

In 2025, the Board of Supervisors established Community and Economic Vitality as a countywide priority and directed the development of Marin's first comprehensive, regional Economic Vitality Roadmap. The Roadmap brings together the County, Marin's 11 cities and towns, businesses, educational institutions, community organizations, and other partners to develop a shared vision and actionable strategies for Marin's economic future.

The Roadmap will explore opportunities related to vibrant downtown and commercial areas, workforce and housing, small business and entrepreneurship, agriculture and working lands, tourism, arts and culture, innovation, and long-term economic resilience.

We collaborate—across the globe—to tackle problems, to pursue our mission, and to make a real impact in the world. We are diverse, flexible, and supportive, and we believe our team is our most important asset, and we offer a host of benefits and programs to ensure that they know it.

This includes developing, optimizing, and maintaining FP&A datasets and reporting platforms. The FP&A Analyst will play a key role by delivering accurate and timely information for our investors, board members, and our internal stakeholders.

You seek to understand business drivers and KPIs, and you have a deep understanding of and comfort with SaaS metrics. Coordinate with all levels of management to gather inputs and to provide valuable performance analysis and management reporting by highlighting key business performance risks, issues and opportunities. Support management with analyses on project profitability, pricing, and ROI of new product and program initiatives.

Use AI to create, iterate, and scale automated models to supplement and replace manual processes.

new_jobs.description:
### **About HMA**

  

HMA Mortgage is a retail independent mortgage bank licensed in 35 jurisdictions. Our Compliance team protects the company from regulatory, financial, and reputational loss while keeping originations moving. As a Senior Compliance Analyst, you will independently own critical regulatory reporting, serve as a go-to resource for the business on day-to-day compliance questions, and help us stay exam-ready. You will work directly with senior leadership and have real influence on how our compliance program grows.

  

### **What You'll Do**

**Regulatory Reporting**

  

* Serve as the owner of the company's regulatory reporting — HMDA (LAR), the quarterly Mortgage Call Report, and NMLS state reporting — accountable for accuracy, the submission calendar, and the supporting documentation, running the reporting cycle independently with the SVP as oversight.

* Own HMDA data integrity end to end: scrub, validate, correct, and submit the annual LAR, and perform ongoing quarterly checks.

* Prepare and submit the quarterly Mortgage Call Report (MCR) and state-level reporting through NMLS, with accurate reconciliation to financial and loan data.

* Prepare and file annual state mortgage reports, as applicable by jurisdiction, including state-specific annual filings submitted through NMLS or directly to the state regulator, and track each state’s requirements and due dates.

  

**Compliance Advisory and Monitoring**

  

* Serve as the first point of contact for business-line questions on TRID, RESPA, TILA, ECOA/Reg B, GLBA, and UDAAP, escalating complex or high-risk issues to the SVP.

* Review marketing, advertising, and social media content for compliance before use.

* Conduct risk-based transactional testing and monitoring, document findings, and track remediation to closure.

* Perform root cause analysis on errors and recommend control improvements.

  

**Licensing and Third-Party Oversight**

  

* Own the third-party risk program end to end — maintain the vendor inventory and risk tiering, collect and review due diligence materials (financials, SOC reports, insurance, licensing, information security questionnaires , track remediation and periodic reviews through the vendor inventory, and escalating high-risk issues to the SVP.

* Support company and individual licensing: applications, renewals, amendments, and multi-state requirements.

* Monitor Marketing Services Agreements (MSAs) and similar referral arrangements for RESPA Section 8 compliance, including fair-market-value support, payment review, and periodic testing.

  

**Audits and Examinations**

  

* Coordinate regulator, investor, and internal audit requests: gather loan files and data, prepare responses, and track findings.

* Help draft exam responses and corrective action plans.

  

**Compliance Program Support**

  

* Monitor regulatory changes and flag business impact.

* Help maintain policies, procedures, and training content.

* Produce clear, concise reporting for leadership.

* Coordinate and oversee the work of third-party compliance resources (e.g., outsourced consultants or testing firms): communicate scope and deadlines, review deliverables for quality and completeness, track findings and remediation, and escalate performance or risk concerns to the SVP.

  

### **What You Bring**

  

* 5+ years of mortgage compliance experience, including hands-on HMDA and MCR preparation.
* Working knowledge of TRID, RESPA, TILA, ECOA, GLBA, and UDAAP, as applied to real loan files.
* Experience supporting regulatory or investor exams and audits.
* Strong analytical skills and comfort with large data sets (advanced Excel required; HMDA software and LOS experience a plus).
* Clear, concise writing, and the judgment to explain risk in business terms.
* Self-starter who thrives in a small team and can manage multiple deadlines without close supervision.
* Experience working with outside consultants or service providers and holding them to deliverables and timelines (preferred).
* Experience with third-party/vendor risk management, including due diligence reviews and risk assessments (preferred).
* Bachelor's degree preferred, or equivalent experience.

Preferred: CRCM or similar certification; experience with multi-state licensing and NMLS; experience in a retail origination environment.  

**HMA****Core Values in This Role**

These values are the behavioral standard for the role, assessed alongside results. Results delivered in a way that violates them do not count as results.

* **Integrity —** a compliance position is defensible on the regulation and the record, not on who is asking for the answer. Pressure never changes what the rule requires.

* **Grit —** the hard regulatory question gets the full analysis, not a convenient read. Rule changes, new reporting cycles, and exam pressure are absorbed without a drop in quality.

* **Accountability —** regulatory accuracy belongs to this seat. When a finding or error lands, this role arrives with the cause, the correction, and the control that prevents a repeat.

* **Service —** the business lines, Sales, and leadership are all customers. The test is whether the next person can act on the guidance without chasing it, and move the loan forward compliantly.

* **Humility —** root cause is pursued even when it points at our own process. Getting the control right matters more than being right about who caused the gap.

* **Speed of Response —** compliance questions and escalations receive a response inside a defined window. The acknowledgment is owed immediately; the answer is owed on a clock.

  

**Equal Opportunity**

HMA Mortgage is an equal opportunity employer. This job description describes the general nature of the role and is not an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, or skills required.
